spec.comparison: Scan 5, 7, 9 or 11 measured pictures inside four-picture flanks. Require same shot, exact native times, and complete descriptors. Use signed changes against the larger absolute flank shift. Independent sectors can change per picture; the persistent arm needs the same three or more sectors, sign and channel in at least three quarters of core pictures, with stable native face position.
spec.coverage: At least 75% measured in each held class, separate from any confidence estimate.
spec.descriptor: Fixed eye/mouth geometry selects four contiguous native-coordinate bands around each of three ellipses, in eight angular sectors. In each sector measure signed adjacent-band second differences in median chroma and log fine-detail energy. Subtract the same descriptors measured beside the visible upper face.
spec.input: One upright exact native track with a visible face. Eighty-millisecond target grid, native sample times retained.
spec.point: Strict exceedance of the third largest ordinary development maximum, with floor 0.15. No edited examples fit the point.
